g.text: An agent-operated studio for building and maintaining web apps with EmDash and Cloudflare.
Prepare the environment, describe the brief, build the app, keep the source.
Source and data live in the project and cloud account you choose.
EmDash gives editors content models, fields and revisions — not a locked page builder.
Independent apps ship on their own domain, with their own resources and release.
The studio and its installed apps · real capture
D1 records · R2 media · service bindings
Prove the environment and an HTTPS origin.
Capture the brief, content model and fields.
An agent implements the owned application.
Deploy to your account, then improve the same app.
